items.label: Teams: one with AI matched two

components.text: Four studies, four sets of people, tasks and units. Don't compare these figures or add them up.

footnote: Source: Science (Jul 2023), QJE (Feb 2025), HBS working paper 24-013 (Sep 2023), NBER working paper w33641 (Mar 2025)
notes: The good news first. These four are experiments or natural experiments, not self-reported surveys. Writing: 453 college-educated professionals did writing tasks from their own field, and the group with AI finished 40% faster with quality scores 18% higher. That was published in Science. Customer support: 5,172 agents at one company got an AI assistant in stages and resolved 15% more issues per hour on average, published in the Quarterly Journal of Economics. Consulting: in a randomized experiment with 758 consultants, those using AI on 18 tasks within AI's reach were 25.1% faster and completed 12.2% more. Teamwork: 776 employees at a consumer goods company worked on real new-product plans, and one person with AI produced plans as good as a two-person team without AI, in 16.4% less time. The units differ: time, issues resolved, quality. So don't compare them and don't add them up. What they share is the kind of work: writing, editing, summarizing and drafting plans.
